current_prompt.body:
READ the list of items [5, 5, 5, 3, 3, 3, 7, 7]
READ the bin capacity C = 10
APPLY the First Fit algorithm to pack the items into bins
OUTPUT the resulting packing produced by First Fit
COMPUTE an optimal packing that minimizes the number of bins for the same items and capacity
OUTPUT the optimal packing
CALCULATE the gap between the number of bins used by First Fit and the optimal packing
EXPLAIN why the arrival order of items causes First Fit to use more bins than optimal
INCLUDE a self‑test that verifies both packings use all items exactly once and respect the capacity constraint
